parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  source: $json.source,
  plane_issue_id: $json.plane_issue_id,
  plane_identifier: $json.plane_identifier,
  title: $json.title,
  description: $json.description,
  priority: $json.priority,
  state: $json.state,
  state_group: $json.state_group,
  labels: $json.labels,
  assignees: $json.assignees,
  project_id: $json.project_id,
  workspace: $json.workspace,
  url: $json.url,
  created_at: $json.created_at,
  updated_at: $json.updated_at
}) }}

parameters.url: ={{ $env.PLANE_URL }}/api/v2/workspaces/{{ $env.PLANE_WORKSPACE_SLUG }}/projects/{{ $('Map to SD Schema').item.json._plane_project_id }}/work-items/{{ $('Map to SD Schema').item.json._plane_issue_id }}/
